verdict.rationale: Gumloop documents several ways to run agents unattended: scheduled triggers (recurring or one-time), app triggers that fire on external-service events, and webhook triggers that any HTTP POST can call. It also says agents decide which tools to call and in what order, and that a Performance view shows what an agent has been doing in the background. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that triggered background runs work reliably in practice; all evidence is first-party docs.
